+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}

+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateInterior(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                               int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int local_x = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    if (y < n && local_x < local_rows)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,

+void runSimulation(DistributedState& state, int n, int iterations) {
+    if (state.local_rows == 0 || iterations == 0) return;
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);

+    const int down = (state.rank + 1 < active_ranks) ? state.rank + 1 : MPI_PROC_NULL;
+    const dim3 interior_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 interior_grid((n + interior_block.x - 1) / interior_block.x,

+    const dim3 boundary_block(256, 1);

+                             state.local_rows == 1 ? 1 : 2);

+    int current = 0;
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;
+        if (iter != 0)

+
+        // Stage only the two halo rows. Interior GPU work proceeds concurrently.

+        MPI_Finalize();

+                    ranks, omp_get_max_threads(), devices);

+                    global_gpu_bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0));

+    const double local_seconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;
+    double seconds = 0.0;
+    MPI_Reduce(&local_seconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+    std::vector<val_t> energy, flux;
+    gatherResults(state, n, energy, flux);
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        const double milliseconds = seconds * 1000.0;
+        const int measured_iterations = std::max(iterations - 1, 1);
+        const double time_per_iteration = milliseconds / measured_iterations;
+        const double giga_elements_per_second = seconds > 0.0
+            ? (static_cast<double>(measured_iterations) * element_count) / seconds / 1e9 : 0.0;

+        std::printf("  Performance: %.4f GFLOPS\n", giga_elements_per_second * 22.0);
+        std::printf("  Result hash: %016" PRIX64 "\n\n", computeHash(energy, flux));
+        if (options[3]) print_results(energy, "ElementEnergy");
+        if (options[2]) valid = validateResults(energy, flux) ? 1 : 0;
     }

+    MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);

+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateInterior(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                               int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int local_x = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    if (y < n && local_x < local_rows)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                 const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                 int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    if (y >= n || local_rows == 0) return;
+    const int local_x = (blockIdx.y == 0) ? 1 : local_rows;
+    updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                  local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}

+    const int down = (state.rank + 1 < active_ranks) ? state.rank + 1 : MPI_PROC_NULL;
+    const dim3 interior_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 interior_grid((n + interior_block.x - 1) / interior_block.x,

+                             state.local_rows == 1 ? 1 : 2);

+    int current = 0;
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;

+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+

+    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
+    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);

+constexpr val_t TRANSFER = 0.8 * 0.25;
+
+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateRows(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                           const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                           int global_row_begin, int first_local_row,
+                           int row_count, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
+    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                 const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                 int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    if (y >= n || local_rows == 0) return;
+    const int local_x = (blockIdx.y == 0) ? 1 : local_rows;
+    updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                  local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}

+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateRows(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                           const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                           int global_row_begin, int first_local_row,
+                           int row_count, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
+    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+

+constexpr val_t TRANSFER = 0.8 * 0.25;
+
+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateRows(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                           const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                           int global_row_begin, int first_local_row,
+                           int row_count, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
+    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                 const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                 int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    if (y >= n || local_rows == 0) return;
+    const int local_x = (blockIdx.y == 0) ? 1 : local_rows;
+    updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                  local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}

+uint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy, const std::vector<val_t>& flux) {
+    uint64_t result = 0;
+#pragma omp parallel for reduction(^ : result) schedule(static)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(energy.size()); ++i) {
+        uint64_t energy_bits = 0, flux_bits = 0;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits, &energy[static_cast<size_t>(i)], sizeof(energy_bits));

codex
The fresh build now targets the installed GPU architecture directly (avoiding PTX JIT), and the single-rank fast path reduces each iteration to one kernel. The 8×8 reference remains bit-identical on both one and two ranks. I’m doing the final default-size reference comparison and a four-GPU run, plus source-level sanity checks.

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+

+        std::printf("Grid size: %d x %d = %zu elements\n", n, n, element_count);
+        std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
+        std::printf("Validation: %s\n\n", options[2] ? "enabled" : "disabled");
+        std::printf("Building distributed unstructured mesh...\n");
+    }
+
+    DistributedState state;
+    initializeState(state, n);
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        int devices = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&devices));
+        const size_t global_gpu_bytes = 4 * element_count * sizeof(val_t);
+        std::printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI rank(s), %d OpenMP thread(s)/rank, %d visible GPU(s)/node\n",
+                    ranks, omp_get_max_threads(), devices);
+        std::printf("Core GPU state: %.2f MB globally (plus halo buffers)\n\n",
+                    global_gpu_bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
+        std::printf("Running simulation...\n");
+    }
+
+    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
+    runSimulation(state, n, iterations);
+    const double local_seconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;
+    double seconds = 0.0;
+    MPI_Reduce(&local_seconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+    std::vector<val_t> energy, flux;
+    gatherResults(state, n, energy, flux);
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        const double milliseconds = seconds * 1000.0;
+        const int measured_iterations = std::max(iterations - 1, 1);
+        const double time_per_iteration = milliseconds / measured_iterations;
+        const double giga_elements_per_second = seconds > 0.0
+            ? (static_cast<double>(measured_iterations) * element_count) / seconds / 1e9 : 0.0;
+        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", milliseconds);
+        std::printf("Performance:\n");
+        std::printf("  Time per iteration: %.4f ms\n", time_per_iteration);
+        std::printf("  Elements/sec: %.4f GigaElements/s\n", giga_elements_per_second);
+        std::printf("  Performance: %.4f GFLOPS\n", giga_elements_per_second * 22.0);
+        std::printf("  Result hash: %016" PRIX64 "\n\n", computeHash(energy, flux));
+        if (options[3]) print_results(energy, "ElementEnergy");
+        if (options[2]) valid = validateResults(energy, flux) ? 1 : 0;
+    }
+    MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+    destroyState(state);
+    MPI_Finalize();
+    return valid ? 0 : 1;
 }

    23	void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
    24	    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
    25	    int rank = 0;
    26	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    27	    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
    28	                 cudaGetErrorString(status));

    34	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
    35	    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
    36	    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
    37	        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
    38	    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
    39	        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
    40	    return 0.0;
    41	}
    42	
    43	__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
    44	                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
    45	                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
    46	                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
    47	                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
    48	                                               int n) {
    49	    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
    50	    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
    51	    const val_t center = energy[p];
    52	    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
    53	
    54	    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
    55	    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
    56	    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
    57	    if (global_x + 1 < n)
    58	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
    59	    if (global_x > 0)
    60	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
    61	    if (y + 1 < n)
    62	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
    63	    if (y > 0)
    64	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
    65	
    66	    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
    67	    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
    68	}
    69	
    70	__global__ void updateRows(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
    71	                           const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
    72	                           val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
    73	                           val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
    74	                           int global_row_begin, int first_local_row,
    75	                           int row_count, int n) {
    76	    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
    77	    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
    78	    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
    79	    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
    80	        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
    81	                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
    82	}
    83	
    84	__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
    85	                                 const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
    86	                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
    87	                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
    88	                                 int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
    89	    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
    90	    if (y >= n || local_rows == 0) return;
    91	    const int local_x = (blockIdx.y == 0) ? 1 : local_rows;
    92	    updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
    93	                  local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
    94	}

    96	struct DistributedState {
    97	    int rank = 0;
    98	    int ranks = 1;
    99	    int global_row_begin = 0;
   100	    int local_rows = 0;
   101	    size_t owned_count = 0;
   102	    size_t padded_count = 0;
   103	    val_t* energy[2]{nullptr, nullptr};
   104	    val_t* flux[2]{nullptr, nullptr};
   105	    val_t* send_top = nullptr;
   106	    val_t* send_bottom = nullptr;
   107	    val_t* recv_top = nullptr;
   108	    val_t* recv_bottom = nullptr;
   109	    cudaStream_t compute_stream{};
   110	    cudaStream_t communication_stream{};
   111	    cudaEvent_t interior_done{};
   112	    cudaEvent_t iteration_done{};
   113	};
   114	
   115	void partitionRows(int n, int rank, int ranks, int& begin, int& rows) {
   116	    const int base = n / ranks;
   117	    const int extra = n % ranks;
   118	    rows = base + (rank < extra ? 1 : 0);
   119	    begin = rank * base + std::min(rank, extra);
   120	}
   121	
   122	void initializeState(DistributedState& state, int n) {
   123	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &state.rank);
   124	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &state.ranks);
   125	    partitionRows(n, state.rank, state.ranks, state.global_row_begin, state.local_rows);
   126	    state.owned_count = static_cast<size_t>(state.local_rows) * n;
   127	    state.padded_count = static_cast<size_t>(state.local_rows + 2) * n;
   128	
   129	    MPI_Comm local_comm;
   130	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, state.rank,
   131	                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_comm);
   132	    int local_rank = 0;
   133	    MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank);
   134	    int device_count = 0;
   135	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
   136	    if (device_count == 0) {
   137	        if (state.rank == 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA devices are visible.\n");
   138	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
   139	    }
   140	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count));
   141	    MPI_Comm_free(&local_comm);
   142	
   143	    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {
   144	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.energy[b], state.padded_count * sizeof(val_t)));
   145	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.flux[b], state.padded_count * sizeof(val_t)));
   146	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.energy[b], 0, state.padded_count * sizeof(val_t)));
   147	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.flux[b], 0, state.padded_count * sizeof(val_t)));
   148	    }
   149	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&state.send_top, static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t),
   150	                             cudaHostAllocPortable));
   151	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&state.send_bottom, static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t),
   152	                             cudaHostAllocPortable));
   153	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&state.recv_top, static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t),
   154	                             cudaHostAllocPortable));
   155	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&state.recv_bottom, static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t),
   156	                             cudaHostAllocPortable));
   157	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&state.compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   158	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&state.communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   159	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&state.interior_done, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   160	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&state.iteration_done, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   161	
   162	    // OpenMP initializes the rank-local mesh state; CUDA owns it after this copy.
   163	    std::vector<val_t> initial_energy(state.owned_count);
   164	    std::vector<val_t> initial_flux(state.owned_count);
   165	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   166	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(state.owned_count); ++i) {
   167	        initial_energy[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = 0.0;
   168	        initial_flux[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = 0.0;
   169	    }
   170	    if (state.owned_count != 0) {
   171	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.energy[0] + n, initial_energy.data(),
   172	                              state.owned_count * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   173	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.flux[0] + n, initial_flux.data(),
   174	                              state.owned_count * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   175	    }
   176	}
   177	
   178	void destroyState(DistributedState& state) {
   179	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(state.iteration_done));
   180	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(state.interior_done));
   181	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(state.communication_stream));
   182	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(state.compute_stream));
   183	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(state.recv_bottom));
   184	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(state.recv_top));
   185	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(state.send_bottom));
   186	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(state.send_top));
   187	    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {
   188	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.flux[b]));
   189	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.energy[b]));
   190	    }
   191	}

   193	void runSimulation(DistributedState& state, int n, int iterations) {
   194	    if (state.local_rows == 0 || iterations == 0) return;
   195	    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
   196	    const int active_ranks = std::min(n, state.ranks);
   197	    const dim3 interior_block(32, 8);
   198	
   199	    // The one-rank case needs neither halo staging nor a separate boundary kernel.
   200	    if (active_ranks == 1) {
   201	        const dim3 grid((n + interior_block.x - 1) / interior_block.x,
   202	                        (state.local_rows + interior_block.y - 1) / interior_block.y);
   203	        int current = 0;
   204	        for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
   205	            const int next = 1 - current;
   206	            updateRows<<<grid, interior_block, 0, state.compute_stream>>>(
   207	                state.energy[current], state.flux[current], state.energy[next], state.flux[next],
   208	                state.global_row_begin, 1, state.local_rows, n);
   209	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   210	            current = next;
   211	        }
   212	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(state.compute_stream));
   213	        if (current != 0) {
   214	            std::swap(state.energy[0], state.energy[1]);
   215	            std::swap(state.flux[0], state.flux[1]);
   216	        }
   217	        return;
   218	    }
   219	
   220	    const int up = state.global_row_begin > 0 ? state.rank - 1 : MPI_PROC_NULL;
   221	    const int down = (state.rank + 1 < active_ranks) ? state.rank + 1 : MPI_PROC_NULL;
   222	    const dim3 interior_grid((n + interior_block.x - 1) / interior_block.x,
   223	                             state.local_rows > 2
   224	                                 ? (state.local_rows - 2 + interior_block.y - 1) / interior_block.y
   225	                                 : 0);
   226	    const dim3 boundary_block(256, 1);
   227	    const dim3 boundary_grid((n + boundary_block.x - 1) / boundary_block.x,
   228	                             state.local_rows == 1 ? 1 : 2);
   229	
   230	    int current = 0;
   230	    int current = 0;
   231	    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
   232	        const int next = 1 - current;
   233	        if (iter != 0)
   234	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(state.compute_stream, state.iteration_done, 0));
   235	
   236	        // Stage only the two halo rows. Interior GPU work proceeds concurrently.
   237	        if (up != MPI_PROC_NULL)
   238	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.send_top, state.energy[current] + n,
   239	                                       row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   240	                                       state.communication_stream));
   241	        if (down != MPI_PROC_NULL)
   242	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.send_bottom,
   243	                                       state.energy[current] +
   244	                                           static_cast<size_t>(state.local_rows) * n,
   245	                                       row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   246	                                       state.communication_stream));
   247	
   248	        if (state.local_rows > 2) {
   249	            updateRows<<<interior_grid, interior_block, 0, state.compute_stream>>>(
   250	                state.energy[current], state.flux[current], state.energy[next], state.flux[next],
   251	                state.global_row_begin, 2, state.local_rows - 2, n);
   252	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   253	        }
   254	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(state.interior_done, state.compute_stream));
   255	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(state.communication_stream));
   256	
   257	        MPI_Request requests[4];
   258	        int request_count = 0;
   259	        if (up != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   260	            MPI_Irecv(state.recv_top, n, MPI_DOUBLE, up, 101, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   261	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   262	            MPI_Isend(state.send_top, n, MPI_DOUBLE, up, 102, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   263	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   264	        }
   265	        if (down != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   266	            MPI_Irecv(state.recv_bottom, n, MPI_DOUBLE, down, 102, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   267	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   268	            MPI_Isend(state.send_bottom, n, MPI_DOUBLE, down, 101, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   269	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   270	        }
   271	        if (request_count != 0)
   272	            MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
   273	
   274	        if (up != MPI_PROC_NULL)
   275	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(state.energy[current], state.recv_top, row_bytes,
   276	                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, state.communication_stream));
   277	        if (down != MPI_PROC_NULL)
   278	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   279	                state.energy[current] + static_cast<size_t>(state.local_rows + 1) * n,
   280	                state.recv_bottom, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   281	                state.communication_stream));
   282	
   283	        updateBoundaries<<<boundary_grid, boundary_block, 0, state.communication_stream>>>(
   284	            state.energy[current], state.flux[current], state.energy[next], state.flux[next],
   285	            state.global_row_begin, state.local_rows, n);
   286	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   287	        // Make one event represent completion of both streams without serializing the kernels.
   288	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(state.communication_stream, state.interior_done, 0));
   289	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(state.iteration_done, state.communication_stream));
   290	        current = next;
   291	    }
   292	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(state.iteration_done));
   293	
   294	    if (current != 0) {
   295	        std::swap(state.energy[0], state.energy[1]);
   296	        std::swap(state.flux[0], state.flux[1]);
   297	    }
   298	}
   299	
   300	void gatherResults(const DistributedState& state, int n,
   301	                   std::vector<val_t>& global_energy, std::vector<val_t>& global_flux) {
   302	    std::vector<val_t> local_energy(state.owned_count);
   303	    std::vector<val_t> local_flux(state.owned_count);
   304	    if (state.owned_count != 0) {
   305	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local_energy.data(), state.energy[0] + n,
   306	                              state.owned_count * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   307	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local_flux.data(), state.flux[0] + n,
   308	                              state.owned_count * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   309	    }
   310	
   311	    std::vector<int> counts(state.ranks), displacements(state.ranks);
   312	    for (int r = 0; r < state.ranks; ++r) {
   313	        int begin = 0, rows = 0;
   314	        partitionRows(n, r, state.ranks, begin, rows);
   315	        counts[r] = rows * n;
   316	        displacements[r] = begin * n;
   317	    }
   318	    if (state.rank == 0) {
   319	        global_energy.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n) * n);
   320	        global_flux.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n) * n);
   321	    }
   322	    MPI_Gatherv(local_energy.data(), static_cast<int>(state.owned_count), MPI_DOUBLE,
   323	                global_energy.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,
   324	                0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   325	    MPI_Gatherv(local_flux.data(), static_cast<int>(state.owned_count), MPI_DOUBLE,
   326	                global_flux.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,
   327	                0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   328	}
   329	
   330	uint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy, const std::vector<val_t>& flux) {
   331	    uint64_t result = 0;
   332	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(^ : result) schedule(static)
   333	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(energy.size()); ++i) {
   334	        uint64_t energy_bits = 0, flux_bits = 0;
   335	        std::memcpy(&energy_bits, &energy[static_cast<size_t>(i)], sizeof(energy_bits));
   336	        std::memcpy(&flux_bits, &flux[static_cast<size_t>(i)], sizeof(flux_bits));
   337	        const uint64_t index = static_cast<uint64_t>(i);
   338	        result ^= (energy_bits + index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   339	        result ^= (flux_bits + index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
   340	    }
   341	    return result;
   342	}
   343	
   344	bool validateResults(const std::vector<val_t>& energy, const std::vector<val_t>& flux) {
   345	    val_t energy_sum = 0.0, flux_sum = 0.0;
   346	    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
   347	    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   348	    for (size_t i = 0; i < energy.size(); ++i) {
   349	        energy_sum += energy[i];
   350	        flux_sum += flux[i];
   351	        energy_max = std::max(energy[i], energy_max);
   352	        energy_min = std::min(energy[i], energy_min);
   353	    }
   354	    std::printf("Validation results:\n");
   355	    std::printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", energy_sum);
   356	    std::printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", flux_sum);
   357	    std::printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", energy_min, energy_max);
   358	    bool valid = true;
   359	    if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum) || !std::isfinite(flux_sum) ||
   360	        !std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {
   361	        std::printf("  ERROR: simulation produced a non-finite result\n");
   362	        valid = false;
   363	    }
   364	    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > 1e-8)
   365	        std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
   366	    std::printf("  Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   367	    return valid;
   368	}

   371	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", program);
   372	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   373	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN elements) (default: 512)\n");
   374	    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of simulation iterations (default: 10)\n");
   375	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   376	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   377	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   378	}

   390	    if (rank == 0) {

   392	            if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) options[0] = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   393	            else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) options[1] = std::atoi(argv[++i]);

   403	            std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid size must be in [1, 46340] and iterations must be nonnegative.\n");
   404	            options[4] = 0;

   409	    if (options[4] != 1) {
   410	        MPI_Finalize();

   412	    }
   413	
   414	    const int n = options[0], iterations = options[1];
   415	    const size_t element_count = static_cast<size_t>(n) * n;
   416	    if (rank == 0) {

   418	        std::printf("============================================\n");
   419	        std::printf("Grid size: %d x %d = %zu elements\n", n, n, element_count);

   422	        std::printf("Building distributed unstructured mesh...\n");

   431	        std::printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI rank(s), %d OpenMP thread(s)/rank, %d visible GPU(s)/node\n",

   444

   451	        const double time_per_iteration = milliseconds / measured_iterations;
   452	        const double giga_elements_per_second = seconds > 0.0
   453	            ? (static_cast<double>(measured_iterations) * element_count) / seconds / 1e9 : 0.0;

+constexpr val_t TRANSFER = 0.8 * 0.25;

+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateRows(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                           const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                           int global_row_begin, int first_local_row,
+                           int row_count, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
+    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                 const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                 int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    if (y >= n || local_rows == 0) return;
+    const int local_x = (blockIdx.y == 0) ? 1 : local_rows;
+    updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                  local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}

+void runSimulation(DistributedState& state, int n, int iterations) {
+    if (state.local_rows == 0 || iterations == 0) return;
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const int active_ranks = std::min(n, state.ranks);
+    const dim3 interior_block(32, 8);
+
+    // The one-rank case needs neither halo staging nor a separate boundary kernel.
+    if (active_ranks == 1) {
+        const dim3 grid((n + interior_block.x - 1) / interior_block.x,
+                        (state.local_rows + interior_block.y - 1) / interior_block.y);
+        int current = 0;
+        for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
+            const int next = 1 - current;
+            updateRows<<<grid, interior_block, 0, state.compute_stream>>>(

codex
Implemented the unconditional MPI + OpenMP + CUDA hybrid version without adding files or changing the executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI row-slab decomposition with nonblocking halo exchange.
- CUDA stencil kernels with double-buffered GPU state.
- Overlapped interior computation and pinned-memory communication.
- OpenMP initialization and parallel result hashing.
- Automatic node-local GPU assignment per MPI rank.
- Single-rank optimized CUDA path.
- Bit-for-bit preservation of original floating-point results.
- Updated CMake for required MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA compilation.

Modified:

+void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    int rank = 0;

+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: CUDA failure in %s: %s\n", rank, operation,
+                 cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) cudaCheck((call), #call)
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int y, int n) {
+    // These tests reproduce the assignment order in buildSquare2D, including n=1.
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == n - 1)) return 0.5;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && y == n - 1) ||
+        (global_x == n - 1 && y == 0)) return -0.5;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                               const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                               val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                               int local_x, int global_x, int y,
+                                               int n) {
+    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + y;
+    const val_t center = energy[p];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, y, n);
+
+    // Keep the reference neighbor order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations retain the reference's non-contracted
+    // arithmetic while allowing contraction elsewhere in the CUDA translation unit.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (global_x > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - pitch] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y + 1 < n)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p + 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+    if (y > 0)
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, __dmul_rn(energy[p - 1] - center, TRANSFER));
+
+    next_energy[p] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    next_flux[p] = __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[p], fabs(flux));
+}
+
+__global__ void updateRows(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                           const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                           val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                           int global_row_begin, int first_local_row,
+                           int row_count, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
+    const int local_x = first_local_row + row_offset;
+    if (y < n && row_offset < row_count)
+        updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                      local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
+
+__global__ void updateBoundaries(const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+                                 const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ next_flux,
+                                 int global_row_begin, int local_rows, int n) {
+    const int y = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
+    if (y >= n || local_rows == 0) return;
+    const int local_x = (blockIdx.y == 0) ? 1 : local_rows;
+    updateElement(energy, accumulated_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                  local_x, global_row_begin + local_x - 1, y, n);
+}
